Localization.Name: Constellation Mk IV Andromeda Model
Localization.Description: This large-scale model is almost as impressive as the storied ship it so meticulously represents. Precise down to the smallest detail, this faithful model makes an impactful statement when displayed on the floor of your hangar; serving as a reminder of the many adventures and discoveries that pilots of the RSI Constellation Mk IV Andromeda were able to experience.
